description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You are reduced to 0 Hit Points or killed.

You keep acting for 1 minute or until the encounter ends. You cannot drop below 1 Hit Point; you are immune to death effects and to the dying, unconscious, and paralyzed conditions; and you ignore the wounded and drained conditions.

When it ends you are dying 3 and your Cloth shatters. If the trigger killed you, you die when the minute ends, beyond the reach of anything short of wish-tier return.

You may end Arayashiki early. If you do, you are merely dying 1 and your Cloth is intact.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Eighth Sense (Arayashiki)]
